claims.statement: Introducing Agent Skills, a new way to build specialized agents using files and folders.

evidence.excerpt: Introducing Agent Skills, a new way to build specialized agents using files and folders.

claims.statement: Update: We've published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability.

evidence.excerpt: Update: We've published Agent Skills as an open standard for cross-platform portability.

claims.statement: (December 18, 2025) As model capabilities improve, we can now build general-purpose agents that interact with full-fledged computing environments.

evidence.excerpt: (December 18, 2025) As model capabilities improve, we can now build general-purpose agents that interact with full-fledged computing environments.

claims.statement: Claude Code , for example, can accomplish complex tasks across domains using local code execution and filesystems.

evidence.excerpt: Claude Code , for example, can accomplish complex tasks across domains using local code execution and filesystems.

claims.statement: But as these agents become more powerful, we need more composable, scalable, and portable ways to equip them with domain-specific expertise.

evidence.excerpt: But as these agents become more powerful, we need more composable, scalable, and portable ways to equip them with domain-specific expertise.

claims.statement: This led us to create Agent Skills : organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and load dynamically to perform better at specific tasks.

evidence.excerpt: This led us to create Agent Skills : organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and load dynamically to perform better at specific tasks.

claims.statement: Skills extend Claude’s capabilities by packaging your expertise into composable resources for Claude, transforming general-purpose agents into specialized agents that fit your needs.

evidence.excerpt: Skills extend Claude’s capabilities by packaging your expertise into composable resources for Claude, transforming general-purpose agents into specialized agents that fit your needs.

claims.statement: Building a skill for an agent is like putting together an onboarding guide for a new hire.

evidence.excerpt: Building a skill for an agent is like putting together an onboarding guide for a new hire.

claims.statement: Instead of building fragmented, custom-designed agents for each use case, anyone can now specialize their agents with composable capabilities by capturing and sharing their procedural knowledge.

evidence.excerpt: Instead of building fragmented, custom-designed agents for each use case, anyone can now specialize their agents with composable capabilities by capturing and sharing their procedural knowledge.

claims.statement: In this article, we explain what Skills are, show how they work, and share best practices for building your own.

evidence.excerpt: In this article, we explain what Skills are, show how they work, and share best practices for building your own.

claims.statement: A skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file that contains organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that give agents additional capabilities.

evidence.excerpt: A skill is a directory containing a SKILL.md file that contains organized folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that give agents additional capabilities.

claims.statement: Agent Skills are a lightweight, open format for extending AI agent capabilities with specialized knowledge and workflows.

evidence.excerpt: Agent Skills are a lightweight, open format for extending AI agent capabilities with specialized knowledge and workflows.

claims.statement: At its core, a skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file.

evidence.excerpt: At its core, a skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file.

claims.statement: This file includes metadata ( name and description , at minimum) and instructions that tell an agent how to perform a specific task.

evidence.excerpt: This file includes metadata ( name and description , at minimum) and instructions that tell an agent how to perform a specific task.

claims.statement: Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.

evidence.excerpt: Skills can also bundle scripts, reference materials, templates, and other resources.

evidence.excerpt: Skills are folders that include instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude can load when needed.

claims.statement: Claude will only access a skill when it's relevant to the task at hand.

claims.statement: How Skills work While working on tasks, Claude scans available skills to find relevant matches.

evidence.excerpt: How Skills work While working on tasks, Claude scans available skills to find relevant matches.

claims.statement: When one matches, it loads only the minimal information and files needed—keeping Claude fast while accessing specialized expertise.

evidence.excerpt: When one matches, it loads only the minimal information and files needed—keeping Claude fast while accessing specialized expertise.
